# gutenberg-block-library

Accessible server-rendered Gutenberg blocks with a WordPress block-grammar parser and serializer, attribute validation and markup that passes axe-core with zero violations. Namespace `Trysac\GutenbergBlockLibrary`, PHP 8.4.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): Installation and basic usage.
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Library design.
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): Strategy and test coverage.
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): Threat model and limits.
